title: The ECB seeks price stability over the medium term and allows short-term deviations
summary: The ECB seeks price stability over the medium term and allows short-term deviations.
body: The ECB says it seeks price stability over the medium term, which allows short-term deviations, provides flexibility, and makes it possible to cater for other considerations. The source says: "This allows for short-term deviations of inflation from its target, provides the necessary flexibility and makes it possible to cater for other considerations." A monthly miss of 2 percent is not, on this page, itself a breach of the strategy. The horizon the Council states is the medium term.
